acerca_titulo: Our History, Values and Commitment to Your Well-Being
acerca_desc: Safe and empathetic psychotherapeutic practice founded by Lic. Sofia Reynaga Pachas (C.Ps.P. 49425), dedicated to comprehensive mental health, evidence-based therapies, and developmental workshops.
historia_titulo: Psychological Guidance with Scientific Foundation and Human Warmth
historia_parrafo_1: At America Psychological Clinic, we were founded with a fundamental purpose: to provide a safe, warm, and judgment-free space where every individual, couple, and family can heal, build resilience, and achieve lasting emotional well-being.
historia_parrafo_2: Under the clinical leadership of Lic. Sofia Reynaga Pachas, licensed by the Colegio de Psicólogos del Perú (C.Ps.P. 49425), holding postgraduate studies in Clinical Psychology and an academic internship at Universidade de São Paulo (USP), we apply evidence-based interventions with the highest ethical standards.
pilar_1_desc: Every session is strictly protected by professional secrecy and the code of ethics of the Peruvian College of Psychologists.
pilar_2_desc: We integrate Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT), and personalized psychopedagogy.
pilar_3_desc: Offices in Miraflores and Villa El Salvador, alongside seamless online therapy via Google Meet and Zoom worldwide.
pilar_4_desc: We set measurable therapeutic objectives and actionable tools that you can apply in your daily life starting from session one.
mision_desc: Guide children, adolescents, adults, and couples toward emotional harmony through compassionate, scientific therapies that empower independence and personal fulfillment.
vision_desc: To be a leading psychological center in Peru and online, recognized for therapeutic excellence, clinical rigor, and human connection.
